news.title: The Insurance Industry’s Retreat from AI Threatens to Slow Innovation and Adoption

news.title: From Shahed to Geran: How Russia Continues to Reinvent the One-Way Attack Drone
news.summary_en: Since acquiring the original design from Iran, Russia has treated the Geran as a base platform for unprecedented wartime iteration. In a new brief, Kateryna Bondar and Nicole Errera trace the drone's evolution and draw lessons for U.S. policymakers.

news.title: U.S.-Africa Trade at a Crossroads: A Moment for New Thinking
news.summary_en: AGOA has been extended for two years, but U.S.-Africa trade remains stagnant. The extension provides an opportunity to develop a new framework that meets the commercial goals and ambitions of the United States and African countries.

news.title: (Still) Awaiting Launch: Space Export Control Reform
news.summary_en: U.S. space companies deserve a level playing field abroad. Long-awaited export control reforms must account for foreign competition, strengthen international partnerships, and keep pace with a rapidly changing global market.

news.title: Strategic Partnerships to Secure Critical Resources and Supply Chains
news.summary_en: The United States does not have sufficient domestic geological resources to meet its mineral needs for sectors vital to national security, economic competitiveness, and energy resilience. International partnerships not optional; they are a fundamental component of U.S. mineral security.
